text: Name bones in the human body

answers.label: Skull
answers.desc: bony or cartilaginous structure that forms the skeleton of head in vertebrates

answers.label: Frontal bone
answers.desc: skull bone

answers.label: Parietal bone
answers.desc: bone in the human skull which, when joined together, forms the sides and roof of the cranium

answers.label: Temporal bone
answers.desc: bones situated at the sides and base of the skull, and lateral to the temporal lobes of the cerebrum

answers.label: Occipital bone
answers.desc: saucer-shaped membrane bone situated at the back and lower part of the cranium

answers.label: Sphenoid
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Ethmoid
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Mandible
answers.desc: lower jaw bone

answers.label: Maxilla
answers.desc: upper jawbone formed from the fusion of two maxillary bones; includes the frontal portion of the palate of the mouth

answers.label: Zygomatic bone
answers.desc: facial bone

answers.label: Nasal bone
answers.desc: facial bone

answers.label: Lacrimal bone
answers.desc: smallest and most fragile bone of the human skull and face

answers.label: Palatine bone
answers.desc: facial bone

answers.label: Vomer
answers.desc: facial bone

answers.label: Hyoid
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Malleus
answers.desc: bone of the middle ear (handle of malleus 5 mm, head of malleus: 2 mm)

answers.label: Incus
answers.desc: bone in the middle ear

answers.label: Stapes
answers.desc: bone of the middle ear

answers.label: Spine
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Vertebra
answers.desc: bone in the spinal column

answers.label: Atlas
answers.desc: first cervical vertebra of the spine

answers.label: Axis
answers.desc: second cervical vertebra of the spine

answers.label: Cervical vertebrae
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Thoracic vertebrae
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Lumbar vertebrae
answers.desc: vertebrae in the region of the lower back, below the thoracic vertebrae and above the sacral vertebrae

answers.label: Sacrum
answers.desc: triangular-shaped bone at the bottom of the spine

answers.label: Coccyx
answers.desc: bone of the pelvis

answers.label: Rib
answers.desc: long curved bone surrounding the chest

answers.label: Sternum
answers.desc: flat bone in the middle front part of the rib cage

answers.label: Manubrium
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Xiphoid process
answers.desc: small cartilaginous process (extension) of the lower part of the sternum which is usually ossified in the adult human

answers.label: Clavicle
answers.desc: plain bone of short length that serves as a strut between the scapula and the sternum

answers.label: Scapula
answers.desc: bone that connects the humerus (upper arm bone) with the clavicle (collar bone)

answers.label: Humerus
answers.desc: long bone of the upper arm

answers.label: Radius
answers.desc: one of the two long bones of the forearm

answers.label: Ulna
answers.desc: long bone in the forearm

answers.label: Carpals
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Scaphoid
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Lunate
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Triquetrum
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Pisiform
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Trapezium
answers.desc: bone of the wrist

answers.label: Trapezoid
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Capitate
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Hamate
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Metacarpals
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Phalanges
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Pelvis
answers.desc: lower part of the trunk of the human body between the abdomen and the thighs (sometimes also called pelvic region of the trunk

answers.label: Ilium
answers.desc: uppermost and largest part of the hip bone, and appears in most vertebrates (including mammals and birds), but not bony fish or snakes

answers.label: Ischium
answers.desc: lower and back part of the hip bone

answers.label: Pubis
answers.desc: anatomical region

answers.label: Femur
answers.desc: femur bone

answers.label: Patella
answers.desc: bone of the leg in front of the knee

answers.label: Tibia
answers.desc: long bone of the lower leg

answers.label: Fibula
answers.desc: leg bone next to the tibia

answers.label: Tarsals
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Talus
answers.desc: one of the group of foot bones forming the lower part of the ankle joint

answers.label: Calcaneus
answers.desc: bone of the foot

answers.label: Navicular
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Cuboid
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Cuneiform
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Metatarsals
answers.desc: A bone in the human body

answers.label: Sesamoid
answers.desc: A bone in the human body
